company.name: Ajman Bank
company.shortDescription: Ajman Bank is a young, agile Islamic commercial bank built on the values of integrity, trust and transparency.
company.description: Ajman Bank is a commercial bank that operates as a full-fledged Islamic bank, offering Shari’ah-compliant financial services. The bank provides a range of products including current and savings accounts, credit cards, personal and auto finance, home financing, and investment options like Islamic investment funds and Sukuk trading. Ajman Bank also offers digital banking services such as internet and mobile banking.
